question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The detective's job was to __discern__ the truth from the web of lies.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"discern"** means to recognize, detect, or perceive something clearly, especially by examining it closely. (पहचानना, समझना)

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist was able to discern the subtle differences between the two chemical compounds.
 
 
 
• **"Perceive"** refers to the ability to become aware of or understand something through the senses or intellect. (अनुभव करना, समझना)
 
 
• **Example:** She perceived the tension in the room as soon as she entered.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"discern"** is **"perceive"**, as both words deal with recognizing or understanding something clearly.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Ignore** (अनदेखा करना): To deliberately pay no attention to something.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to ignore the rude comments and focus on his work.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Confuse** (भ्रमित करना): To make someone unclear or unsure about something.
 
 
• **Example:** The complex instructions confused the students.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Fabricate** (गढ़ना): To invent or concoct something, often with the intention of deceiving.
 
 
• **Example:** She fabricated an excuse to avoid attending the meeting.
 
 

30:Tb56,
The correct answer is Option 1</
